title: SoftBrown-KnightLib+companions
description: Added vanllia-like SoftBrown material and UI to KnightLib and companions
body:
为companions!制作的低饱和度原版like材质包。

将铜的色调调低，灵魂的颜色略微调蓝，紫色系红色系物品饱和度调整，部分方块实体物品纹理进行重绘。

目前为所有灵魂和铜相关做了色调调整，方块完全适配，实体和物品部分适配。

背景中使用的材质包是excalibur，这同时也是我最喜欢的材质包。

淡雅棕材质包灵感来源于excalibur因此也完全适配excalibur。
__________________________________________________________

_我正在为中世纪风格的资源包和模组创建兼容的纹理，以及为单个项目创建自定义纹理。你也可以通过爱发电或者Ko-fi支持我。
[爱发电](https://ifdian.net/a/littlh0428/plan)_

﻿
For [companions!](https://modrinth.com/mod/companions-mod)A low saturation original like material pack made.

Lower the color tone of copper, slightly adjust the color of the soul to blue, adjust the saturation of purple and red items, and redraw the texture of some solid block items.

At present, color tone adjustments have been made for all souls and copper related items, with blocks fully adapted and entities and items partially adapted.

The background pack used is [Excalibur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excal), which is also my favorite material pack.

The pack is inspired by Excalibur and therefore fully compatible with Excalibur.
